I replied to Dana in her DM: she told me on Oct 14 that her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is Dock 38.

Two sources match: her original message in this DM (DSHARED0001) and the note I saved for her in gbrain.

Last time I said I couldn't confirm the gbrain note was private, because it was labelled `visibility: "world"`. That's still unconfirmed. The recall tool's description says remote callers can only read "world" facts, so "world" may just be the label every fact saved this way gets. That doesn't prove other members can't read it.
